name: Manhattan Mini AM 2025
information:
This is a series competition with [Manhattan Mini PM 2025](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ManhattanMiniPM2025). You may only register for and compete in one of the two competitions. If you have already registered (with payment) for Manhattan Mini PM 2025, your registration for this competition will be rejected.
​
Note: 3x3 One-handed will be the main event. 3x3 will **NOT** be held at this competition.
​
